meta.description: CareTrail screening rules, extracted from two public Department of Health - Abu Dhabi standards. Every rule cites its source section. Prototype use only; not a clinical decision tool.

sources.IFHAS: Standard for the Provision of the Periodic Comprehensive Screening Program for Adults - IFHAS, DoH/SD/ADPHC-CHS/IFHAS/V10/2025, July 2025
sources.WCV: Standard for Well-Child Visits, DOH/WCV/SD/10/2025, V10, December 2025

assumptions: A package is 'due' from the date its interval elapses and 'overdue' 90 days after that (CareTrail assumption; the standards do not define a grace window).
A Well-Child visit is 'due' from its scheduled age until the next scheduled age, and 'missed' after that (CareTrail assumption).
Colorectal screening is satisfied by any current modality: FIT (1 y), colonoscopy (10 y) or liquid biopsy (3 y, restricted eligibility).
The childhood immunization schedule is set by a separate DoH/ADPHC circular (No. 39/2024) and is not encoded here.

packages.name: Comprehensive Screening Major Package
packages.note: Listed separately for 18-39, 40-64 and 65-75 with identical contents and frequency.

packages.name: Vision Screening (minor package)
components: Consultation + dilated fundus examination by ophthalmologist

packages.name: Female Reproductive Health Screening
packages.abnormal_rule: Any FRHQ 'Yes' -> gynecologist evaluation; abnormal AMH -> OB/GYN referral; if both abnormal follow the AMH pathway.

packages.name: Male Reproductive Health Screening
packages.abnormal_rule: Abnormal -> urology referral; smokers -> consider smoking cessation clinic.

inclusion: Unwilling to have a colonoscopy or FIT
exclusion: Known hereditary/germline colorectal cancer risk (e.g. Lynch syndrome, FAP)

packages.name: Lung Cancer Screening (low-dose CT)
high_risk_criteria: 30 pack-year smoking history, and/or quit less than 15 years ago
20 pack-year history and/or quit less than 15 years ago, plus one additional risk factor
20-year history of water pipe (shisha), dokha, medwakh or other smoked tobacco

referral_pathway.PHQ-9 / GAD-7: Psychiatrist, psychologist or family physician with mental health privilege
referral_pathway.Mammography / Gail model: Family medicine, gynecologist, medical oncology or breast surgeon
referral_pathway.Random blood sugar / HbA1c: GP, family physician, internal medicine or endocrinologist
referral_pathway.Lipid panel / blood pressure: GP, family physician, internal medicine or cardiologist
referral_pathway.Serum creatinine: GP, family physician, internal medicine or nephrologist
referral_pathway.CBC: Family physician, internal medicine or hematologist
referral_pathway.note: General recommendation only; the final decision rests with the clinician based on severity and the participant's overall condition.

ifhas.invitation_system: Invitations for first screening, rescreening, and recall for positive and insufficient results (IFHAS 4.7.1); appointment reminders to improve coverage and uptake (IFHAS 4.2.13).
ifhas.preconception_prompt: Married women of childbearing age: ask about plans to conceive and consider a preconception clinic referral (IFHAS 4.8.2.3).
ifhas.education_material_rule: Providers must use ADPHC-developed educational material, coordinate campaigns with ADPHC, and link to the ADPHC website instead of writing their own screening information (IFHAS 4.10.4).

kpis.definition: Eligible registered individuals who completed screening / eligible registered individuals, per package per quarter
Participants with abnormal findings / participants who completed the package, per quarter
Participants with abnormal findings referred within 15 working days / participants with abnormal findings

questionnaire_fields.consanguinity: Are your parents related to each other?

components.name: Hip exam: abduction, limb length, skin folds
Hearing test if missed or failed at birth
components.conditional: newborn hearing screen not done or failed

components.name: Oral screening by dentist or hygienist

mchat_r.action: If screened at 18 months, re-screen at 24 months
Refer to neurodevelopment clinic and speech therapy within 4 weeks; PHC follow-up after 1 month
Refer to neurodevelopment clinic and speech therapy within 2 weeks; PHC follow-up after 1 month

scoring.idaq: Refer to pediatric neurologist or neurodevelopment clinic if Q1 is 'Yes' or any of Q2-Q6 is 'No'.
scoring.cbc: Hemoglobin below 11 g/dL (under 6 years) -> further evaluation.

idaq_questions.en: Do you have any concerns regarding the development of your child?
idaq_questions.ar: هل لديك أي مخاوف بشأن نمو طفلك؟

idaq_questions.en: Does your child walk alone without holding onto anything?
Does your child pick up small objects using their thumb and index finger?
Does your child say at least 6 different words, other than names?
Does your child copy you if you do something simple?
Does your child look at you when you call their name?
idaq_questions.ar: هل يستجيب الطفل عند مناداته باسمه؟

wcv.refusal_rule: If a parent or guardian declines screening, inform them of potential consequences and document the refusal in the child's record (WCV 4.2.1).

kpis.definition: Children who attended the age-appropriate visit, per age category
Children at 12, 15, 18 months with CBC done / attending
